verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm A/R aging reports and per-customer delinquency tracking: "QuickBooks makes it easy to run the A/R aging report to see which customers are late with their payments" and "QuickBooks helps you manage accounts receivable by tracking invoices, payments, and identifying your delinquent accounts," plus statement reminders for late-paying customers. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the aging report's accuracy or per-customer balance detail, and no screenshots or deeper documentation of report customization.
